title: Senior Staff Nurse
must_have: 3+ years of experience in clinical nursing
text:
Senior Staff Nurse
Kalyani Health Trust | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a senior staff nurse to join our clinical nursing team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Vital Signs Monitoring
- IV Therapy
- Basic Life Support
- Infection Control
- Medication Administration
- 3+ years of experience in clinical nursing

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- Pediatric Care
- Electronic Health Records
- ICU Care
- Ventilator Management

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive outpatient department flow with measurable outcomes.
- Drive maternity ward rounds with measurable outcomes.
- Drive emergency admissions workflow with measurable outcomes.
